name: Yantai Zhenghai Magnetic Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Yantai Zhenghai Magnetic Material Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of rare earth permanent magnet materials and components in the People's Republic of China. It owns clean rooms with different classes, full-featured magnetic property, dimension, and shape and reliability test laboratory, as well as offers surface treatment technology. The company's products are used in various applications, such as vehicle, wind turbine, elevator, home appliances, automation, and electronics. Yantai Zhenghai Magnetic Material Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Yantai, China.
